# Erdos.p1044 — Erdős problem 1044

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1044
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1044.lean`, theorem `erdos_1044.variants.fixed_degree`, AMS 30).

Tang also suggests that, if the degree $n$ is fixed, then the infimum over all such $f$ of
degree $n$ is attained by $f_n(z)=z^n-1$.

## Statement
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), IsLeast {L : ℝ≥0∞ | ∃ f : ℂ[X], IsAdmissible f ∧ f.natDegree = n ∧ maxBoundaryLength f = L}
      (maxBoundaryLength (X ^ n - 1))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
